scope: Native Workspace menu (open in place, import a copy, reveal), remembered workspace, unsafe-root refusal and import safety. macOS 1.0.2 core build, ad-hoc signed; not Linux/Windows.
implemented: Shell: Workspace menu (Open Workspace… ⌘O, Import Workspace…, Show Workspace in Finder) via tauri-plugin-dialog 2.8.3; switches stop the current backend cleanly and reopen the owner (never once quitting); desktop.json in the app config folder is written only after a verified launch; a vanished remembered folder shows 'workspace-missing' instead of being replaced.

Framework: check_workspace_root refuses the home folder or any ancestor, system folders and app bundles for native launches (UnsafeWorkspaceError, exit 64, before any write); terminal `nexus studio` unchanged.
Framework: import_workspace refuses nested source/destination and a source locked by another Studio (a copy of a live workspace could be inconsistent).
Frozen entry: --nexus-desktop routes to the existing `nexus desktop` CLI; the shell imports with `--nexus-desktop import --from SRC --dir DST --json`. Debug wrapper now runs the same entry module.

release.install: from DMG to <scratchpad>/Workspace Root/Applications, strict signature verification passed

Remembered folder missing: no backend started; shell stayed on its screen.
Remembered home folder: backend refused with exit 64; home listing unchanged; choice not overwritten.
validation.installed_drills_user: User confirmed the home-folder message, then Open (Project B), Import (Old CLI Workspace; 'Old CLI Agent' visible) and Show in Finder all worked.
verified_on_disk: desktop.json points to <app data>/workspaces/Old CLI Workspace; the copy contains old-cli-agent.yaml; the backend serves and locks it.
Original Old CLI Workspace content hash unchanged.
Project B received Studio state when opened and its lock was released on switching.
validation.cleanup: App data, WebKit and cache folders created by the drill (23:59:53) removed; scratchpad drill folders kept.

compatibility: Native launches now refuse home/system/app-bundle folders. `nexus desktop import` now refuses nested folders and a source open in another Studio. Tracked development wrappers run nexus.core.studio_desktop_sidecar instead of `nexus.cli studio` (same behaviour plus --nexus-desktop). No schema change.
remaining: Pre-import backup restore from the app (imports always target a new folder, so none is created today).
Windows/Linux dialogs, reveal commands and system-folder lists are untested.
Real schema migrations; Developer ID signing; Linux/Windows packages.
